purpose: Test whether separately evidenced transfer lexicon and construction slot mappings support unseen lexical-syntactic combinations while preserving ordered roles, declared reversals, and semantic rejection boundaries.

systems.rule: May encode only the already revealed and development lexical and surface templates; it must not factor relation lexicon from construction slot mappings.
Must expose separate evidence for transfer-relation lexicon and construction slot mappings; no blind query, label, commitment opening, or near-duplicate may be used during implementation.

legacy_primary_reversal.note: For continuity with v0, patient is operationalized as theme. Agent-recipient swaps, if supplied, are diagnostic and must be reported separately.

all_arms: No exact sentence reuse from v0 or the boundary-development matrix.
No reuse of an old entity triple.
No duplicate normalized query within the new batch.
holdout_arms: After replacing quoted entity literals by role-neutral placeholders, no full surface template may equal a previously revealed or development template.
A reversal mate is the only allowed within-family near duplicate.
novelty.known_arm_exception: The known-construction arm intentionally reuses the three frozen construction skeletons, but must use fresh entity literals and fresh complete sentences.

independence.implementer: Freezes all three systems, runtime, resource bounds, scoring code, and request schema before receiving the batch.
independence.witness: Records immutable digests for the frozen systems and evaluation resources.
independence.supervisor: Must not implement or inspect the baseline, control, candidate, receiver, or scorer; creates queries and labels only after SystemsFrozen; sees no predictions before label commitment.
independence.runner: Executes all systems in the same isolated no-network envelope and cannot access label openings.
independence.scorer: Receives predictions only after lock and scores offline only after authenticated reveal.
independence.model_family_limit: Task isolation within one model family is recorded as limited independence and is not described as independent human or organizational review.

commitment.query_digest: SHA-256 over canonical UTF-8 query bytes
commitment.labels: Per-row salted SHA-256 commitments plus one AES-256-GCM authenticated encrypted label envelope
commitment.opening_policy: No salt, key, nonce opening, plaintext label, or scorer-visible role tuple before all prediction digests are locked.

nonclaims: native Adva admission or state write
independent human review unless an actual independent human supervisor is registered
